topics.title: Reserving
topics.objective: The candidate will understand how to apply valuation principles for group and health insurance contracts.

outcomes.text: Describe the types of claim reserves
Explain the limitations and biases of the traditional valuation methods
Calculate appropriate claim reserves given data
Describe, calculate, and evaluate the impact of environmental factors on reserve calculations (trend, seasonality, claim processing changes, etc.)
Evaluate data resources and appropriateness for calculating reserves
Describe, calculate, and evaluate non-IBNR types of reserves and explain when each is required
Apply applicable best practices related to reserving

Evaluate key financial performance measures used by life and health insurers for both short and long-duration contracts
Project financial outcomes and recommend a strategy to senior management to achieve financial goals

Explain fair value accounting principles and describe International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS)
Construct basic financial statements and associated actuarial entries for a life and health insurance company
